results.title: Strategy-specific evidence, coverage gaps and adverse-news exits
results.text: C2 always checks dated evidence before a permitted action. For a code-qualified strong EMA_TREND or confirmed EMA_PULLBACK entry (ADX at least 22, Close above EMA20 above EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI below 42, Close above 0.88 EMA50), missing financial or independent news coverage alone is not an entry veto. Inspect company evidence and attempt bounded dated web retrieval when coverage is missing or unknown. With no identified concrete unresolved adverse event, a LIMITED assessment may use COVERAGE_LIMITED, an observed attempted WEBSCAN or ready official SCAN citation, empty event_risks and explicit coverage limitations. This permits following the technical signal with residual evidence risk; it never establishes clean fundamentals, safety or profit. Concrete potentially serious unresolved event risk remains UNKNOWN and blocks entry; it cannot be hidden as a mere coverage gap. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding can use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT (including BREAKOUT_BOUNCE) entry requires readable dated corroborating company evidence, exact document citations, breakout_support explaining the source-backed support, and a supported adverse assessment. COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Actual cited adverse news uses REVIEW_REQUIRED with ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE and nonempty supported event_risks. Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification, even when a disclosed penalty is small. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. Daily bounded official issuer metadata checks can trigger holding research between scheduled reviews; empty checks make no generation call. Publication and availability must be at or before the historical cutoff; after-close releases are first considered at a later eligible close. A confirmed exit queues a later-open simulated sale, with existing gap/stop/profit protections; no same-close look-ahead and no forced end-period liquidation. Stops, fees, position sizing, Friday/gap refresh, human approval where required and execution remain code controlled. Search failures and truncated sources are recorded; a live dated web lookup is not a certified historical content archive or exhaustive news feed. Lessons cannot override this policy or the independent critic. Breakout corroboration must be structured as document_id, kind, exact contiguous visible quote and relevance, with source availability no more than 30 calendar days before the signal cutoff. Code checks a reported benefit metric and an earnings/operating improvement or completed commercial event; prose alone, an auditor review, vague business focus, provider selection or a prospective forecast is insufficient. Sole support consisting of plans, expected/indicated gains or up-to targets is not an achieved result. The independent critic must separately quote and corroborate the same source; accept=true alone is insufficient. A structurally valid source and critic approval still do not predict price direction. Known recent explicit structural-action disclosures also invoke the raw-price entry quarantine in POL-60. Reject unsupported quotes rather than invent missing evidence; later profit or loss must never select a historical entry.

results.title: Raw-price discontinuities and known structural-action quarantine
results.text: Daily stock screening excludes new candidates for twenty sessions after a raw close-to-close jump above thirty percent. This is a quarantine, not corporate-action adjustment. It cannot repair the economic value of an already-held position affected by a split, bonus or demerger. In addition, a readable non-financial disclosure explicitly titled as a demerger, stock/share split, bonus issue, rights issue or capital reduction and available within the preceding 30 calendar days quarantines new entries on the unadjusted simulator. Use full source metadata before display-title truncation. The reason is price comparability and missing entitlement accounting, not adverse news. Do not use the action itself as positive breakout corroboration or force a holding sale merely because of that label. This bounded disclosure check is not a complete corporate-action calendar and does not repair existing holdings or distributions. Do not treat a raw ex-action stop loss as complete shareholder economic P&L when distributed shares/cash entitlements are unaccounted.

results.title: Backtest fidelity
results.text: Historical entries use completed-session evidence and later eligible opens with fees/slippage. Friday and pre-nontrading-gap candidates are deferred without paid entry research until the next available trading close, then freshly screened and researched before a subsequent-open fill. Monday closing data never justify a Monday-opening fill. Current entries remain provisional historical simulations with survivorship and raw-price limits.

results.title: Entry gap invalidates a stop
results.text: The initial protective stop is fixed from signal-time evidence before the entry fills. If the next eligible open makes that stop invalid or violates sizing constraints, the engine rejects the queued BUY. After a historical fill, an explicitly enabled trailing stop may only rise at a completed close: max(previous stop, highest completed close since entry minus the configured multiple of entry-signal ATR14). The ATR distance stays fixed; a raised stop applies from the next session and cannot be tested against the earlier low of the same bar. The LLM cannot lower or veto this coded protective exit. Historical portfolios may also exit at the configured take-profit percentage, default eight percent NET of modeled entry and exit fees with adverse slippage in execution. Opening gaps are processed before intraday triggers. If an intraday daily bar touches both stop and target without a known order, use the stop first. Stops, targets and code exits cannot be vetoed by an LLM. No final-period liquidation is forced.

results.title: Breakout strategy entry and exit
results.text: BREAKOUT enters on a ready row when Close exceeds the shifted prior 20-session high and ADX14 is at least 18. Its signal exit is Close below EMA20. The current high is not included in Prior20High, preventing a same-session high from entering its own comparison window. Breakout uses separately configured risk (default 0.5% equity), initial stop 2.5 ATR, trailing 2.5 entry ATR activated after 1R close gain. Stop fills first. One later confirmed re-entry per setup is allowed within ten trading sessions: close above stopped level, EMA20 and previous high; ADX>=18; no high-vol or warmup. Fresh C2 and the same strict recent source quote and independent critic are mandatory. Fill at a later eligible open. No same-candle rebuy or averaging down. A second stop exhausts the setup; profit/adverse exits do not create rebound watches. The approved catalogue includes EMA_PULLBACK for PULLBACK: ADX14>=22, EMA20>EMA50, an EMA20 touch holding EMA50 in a prior three-session window, followed by a completed close above EMA20 and prior-session high. Exit on EMA20<EMA50, or code protective/profit/C2 exits. Routing gives this confirmed pullback priority over breakout. BREAKOUT_BOUNCE is portfolio-owned stop/rebound context and routes only to BREAKOUT.

results.title: Strategy-specific evidence, coverage gaps and adverse-news exits
results.text: C2 always checks dated evidence before a permitted action. For a code-qualified strong EMA_TREND or confirmed EMA_PULLBACK entry (ADX at least 22, Close above EMA20 above EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI below 42, Close above 0.88 EMA50), missing financial or independent news coverage alone is not an entry veto. Inspect company evidence and attempt bounded dated web retrieval when coverage is missing or unknown. With no identified concrete unresolved adverse event, a LIMITED assessment may use COVERAGE_LIMITED, an observed attempted WEBSCAN or ready official SCAN citation, empty event_risks and explicit coverage limitations. This permits following the technical signal with residual evidence risk; it never establishes clean fundamentals, safety or profit. Concrete potentially serious unresolved event risk remains UNKNOWN and blocks entry; it cannot be hidden as a mere coverage gap. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding can use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT (including BREAKOUT_BOUNCE) entry requires readable dated corroborating company evidence, exact document citations, breakout_support explaining the source-backed support, and a supported adverse assessment. COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Actual cited adverse news uses REVIEW_REQUIRED with ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE and nonempty supported event_risks. Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification, even when a disclosed penalty is small. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. Daily bounded official issuer metadata checks can trigger holding research between scheduled reviews; empty checks make no generation call. Publication and availability must be at or before the historical cutoff; after-close releases are first considered at a later eligible close. A confirmed exit queues a later-open simulated sale, with existing gap/stop/profit protections; no same-close look-ahead and no forced end-period liquidation. Stops, fees, position sizing, Friday/gap refresh, human approval where required and execution remain code controlled. Search failures and truncated sources are recorded; a live dated web lookup is not a certified historical content archive or exhaustive news feed. Lessons cannot override this policy or the independent critic. Breakout corroboration must be structured as document_id, kind, exact contiguous visible quote and relevance, with source availability no more than 30 calendar days before the signal cutoff. Code checks a reported benefit metric and an earnings/operating improvement or completed commercial event; prose alone, an auditor review, vague business focus, provider selection or a prospective forecast is insufficient. Sole support consisting of plans, expected/indicated gains or up-to targets is not an achieved result. The independent critic must separately quote and corroborate the same source; accept=true alone is insufficient. A structurally valid source and critic approval still do not predict price direction. Known recent explicit structural-action disclosures also invoke the raw-price entry quarantine in POL-60. Reject unsupported quotes rather than invent missing evidence; later profit or loss must never select a historical entry.

results.title: Raw-price discontinuities and known structural-action quarantine
results.text: Daily stock screening excludes new candidates for twenty sessions after a raw close-to-close jump above thirty percent. This is a quarantine, not corporate-action adjustment. It cannot repair the economic value of an already-held position affected by a split, bonus or demerger. In addition, a readable non-financial disclosure explicitly titled as a demerger, stock/share split, bonus issue, rights issue or capital reduction and available within the preceding 30 calendar days quarantines new entries on the unadjusted simulator. Use full source metadata before display-title truncation. The reason is price comparability and missing entitlement accounting, not adverse news. Do not use the action itself as positive breakout corroboration or force a holding sale merely because of that label. This bounded disclosure check is not a complete corporate-action calendar and does not repair existing holdings or distributions. Do not treat a raw ex-action stop loss as complete shareholder economic P&L when distributed shares/cash entitlements are unaccounted.

results.title: Breakout strategy entry and exit
results.text: BREAKOUT enters on a ready row when Close exceeds the shifted prior 20-session high and ADX14 is at least 18. Its signal exit is Close below EMA20. The current high is not included in Prior20High, preventing a same-session high from entering its own comparison window. Breakout uses separately configured risk (default 0.5% equity), initial stop 2.5 ATR, trailing 2.5 entry ATR activated after 1R close gain. Stop fills first. One later confirmed re-entry per setup is allowed within ten trading sessions: close above stopped level, EMA20 and previous high; ADX>=18; no high-vol or warmup. Fresh C2 and the same strict recent source quote and independent critic are mandatory. Fill at a later eligible open. No same-candle rebuy or averaging down. A second stop exhausts the setup; profit/adverse exits do not create rebound watches. The approved catalogue includes EMA_PULLBACK for PULLBACK: ADX14>=22, EMA20>EMA50, an EMA20 touch holding EMA50 in a prior three-session window, followed by a completed close above EMA20 and prior-session high. Exit on EMA20<EMA50, or code protective/profit/C2 exits. Routing gives this confirmed pullback priority over breakout. BREAKOUT_BOUNCE is portfolio-owned stop/rebound context and routes only to BREAKOUT.

results.title: Backtest fidelity
results.text: Historical entries use completed-session evidence and later eligible opens with fees/slippage. Friday and pre-nontrading-gap candidates are deferred without paid entry research until the next available trading close, then freshly screened and researched before a subsequent-open fill. Monday closing data never justify a Monday-opening fill. Current entries remain provisional historical simulations with survivorship and raw-price limits.

results.title: Entry gap invalidates a stop
results.text: The initial protective stop is fixed from signal-time evidence before the entry fills. If the next eligible open makes that stop invalid or violates sizing constraints, the engine rejects the queued BUY. After a historical fill, an explicitly enabled trailing stop may only rise at a completed close: max(previous stop, highest completed close since entry minus the configured multiple of entry-signal ATR14). The ATR distance stays fixed; a raised stop applies from the next session and cannot be tested against the earlier low of the same bar. The LLM cannot lower or veto this coded protective exit. Historical portfolios may also exit at the configured take-profit percentage, default eight percent NET of modeled entry and exit fees with adverse slippage in execution. Opening gaps are processed before intraday triggers. If an intraday daily bar touches both stop and target without a known order, use the stop first. Stops, targets and code exits cannot be vetoed by an LLM. No final-period liquidation is forced.

results.title: Strategy-specific evidence, coverage gaps and adverse-news exits
results.text: C2 always checks dated evidence before a permitted action. For a code-qualified strong EMA_TREND or confirmed EMA_PULLBACK entry (ADX at least 22, Close above EMA20 above EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI below 42, Close above 0.88 EMA50), missing financial or independent news coverage alone is not an entry veto. Inspect company evidence and attempt bounded dated web retrieval when coverage is missing or unknown. With no identified concrete unresolved adverse event, a LIMITED assessment may use COVERAGE_LIMITED, an observed attempted WEBSCAN or ready official SCAN citation, empty event_risks and explicit coverage limitations. This permits following the technical signal with residual evidence risk; it never establishes clean fundamentals, safety or profit. Concrete potentially serious unresolved event risk remains UNKNOWN and blocks entry; it cannot be hidden as a mere coverage gap. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding can use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT (including BREAKOUT_BOUNCE) entry requires readable dated corroborating company evidence, exact document citations, breakout_support explaining the source-backed support, and a supported adverse assessment. COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Actual cited adverse news uses REVIEW_REQUIRED with ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE and nonempty supported event_risks. Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification, even when a disclosed penalty is small. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. results.text: Daily stock screening excludes new candidates for twenty sessions after a raw close-to-close jump above thirty percent. This is a quarantine, not corporate-action adjustment. results.title: Strategy-specific evidence, coverage gaps and adverse-news exits
results.text: C2 always checks dated evidence before a permitted action. For a code-qualified strong EMA_TREND or confirmed EMA_PULLBACK entry (ADX at least 22, Close above EMA20 above EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI below 42, Close above 0.88 EMA50), missing financial or independent news coverage alone is not an entry veto. Inspect company evidence and attempt bounded dated web retrieval when coverage is missing or unknown. With no identified concrete unresolved adverse event, a LIMITED assessment may use COVERAGE_LIMITED, an observed attempted WEBSCAN or ready official SCAN citation, empty event_risks and explicit coverage limitations. This permits following the technical signal with residual evidence risk; it never establishes clean fundamentals, safety or profit. Concrete potentially serious unresolved event risk remains UNKNOWN and blocks entry; it cannot be hidden as a mere coverage gap. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding can use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT (including BREAKOUT_BOUNCE) entry requires readable dated corroborating company evidence, exact document citations, breakout_support explaining the source-backed support, and a supported adverse assessment. COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Actual cited adverse news uses REVIEW_REQUIRED with ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE and nonempty supported event_risks. Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification, even when a disclosed penalty is small. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. Daily bounded official issuer metadata checks can trigger holding research between scheduled reviews; empty checks make no generation call. Publication and availability must be at or before the historical cutoff; after-close releases are first considered at a later eligible close. A confirmed exit queues a later-open simulated sale, with existing gap/stop/profit protections; no same-close look-ahead and no forced end-period liquidation. Stops, fees, position sizing, Friday/gap refresh, human approval where required and execution remain code controlled. Search failures and truncated sources are recorded; a live dated web lookup is not a certified historical content archive or exhaustive news feed. Lessons cannot override this policy or the independent critic. Breakout corroboration must be structured as document_id, kind, exact contiguous visible quote and relevance, with source availability no more than 30 calendar days before the signal cutoff. Code checks a reported benefit metric and an earnings/operating improvement or completed commercial event; prose alone, an auditor review, vague business focus, provider selection or a prospective forecast is insufficient. Sole support consisting of plans, expected/indicated gains or up-to targets is not an achieved result. The independent critic must separately quote and corroborate the same source; accept=true alone is insufficient. A structurally valid source and critic approval still do not predict price direction. Known recent explicit structural-action disclosures also invoke the raw-price entry quarantine in POL-60. Reject unsupported quotes rather than invent missing evidence; later profit or loss must never select a historical entry.

results.title: Entry gap invalidates a stop
results.text: The initial protective stop is fixed from signal-time evidence before the entry fills. If the next eligible open makes that stop invalid or violates sizing constraints, the engine rejects the queued BUY. After a historical fill, an explicitly enabled trailing stop may only rise at a completed close: max(previous stop, highest completed close since entry minus the configured multiple of entry-signal ATR14). The ATR distance stays fixed; a raised stop applies from the next session and cannot be tested against the earlier low of the same bar. The LLM cannot lower or veto this coded protective exit. Historical portfolios may also exit at the configured take-profit percentage, default eight percent NET of modeled entry and exit fees with adverse slippage in execution. Opening gaps are processed before intraday triggers. If an intraday daily bar touches both stop and target without a known order, use the stop first. Stops, targets and code exits cannot be vetoed by an LLM. No final-period liquidation is forced.

results.title: Raw-price discontinuities and known structural-action quarantine
results.text: Daily stock screening excludes new candidates for twenty sessions after a raw close-to-close jump above thirty percent. This is a quarantine, not corporate-action adjustment. It cannot repair the economic value of an already-held position affected by a split, bonus or demerger. In addition, a readable non-financial disclosure explicitly titled as a demerger, stock/share split, bonus issue, rights issue or capital reduction and available within the preceding 30 calendar days quarantines new entries on the unadjusted simulator. Use full source metadata before display-title truncation. The reason is price comparability and missing entitlement accounting, not adverse news.
